IS 3025 : Part 28 : 2024 Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater - Part 28 Sulphites
ICS 13.060.50
ICS 13.060.50
CHD 36
CHD 36
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 28) prescribes the following methods for determination of sulphites in water and wastewater:
a) Iodometric method (applicable to minimum detectable concentration of 2 mg/l); and
b) Phenanthroline method (applicable to minimum detectable concentration of 0.01 mg/l).
